item.title: Former President Moon: "Satisfying Meeting... My Heart is at Ease on the Way to Pyeongsan" (문 전 대통령 “만족스러운 회동…평산 가는 길 마음 놓여”)
item.description:
Former President Moon Jae-in expressed his feelings about his meeting with President Lee Jae-myung on the 1st, saying it was "satisfying." <<> According to Yoon Geon-young, a lawmaker of the Democratic Party of Korea, Former President Moon said this after concluding the meeting with President Lee at the Blue House, before heading to Pyeongsan Village in Yangsan City, South Gyeongsang Province. <<> Former President Moon reportedly said, "We had a candid and open conversation about state affairs as a whole. Compared to when I came up to Seoul, my mind is much more at ease now as I head down to Pyeongsan." <<> During the meeting, which included a lunch at the Blue House, President Lee and Former President Moon discussed various topics, including unity within the ruling party and inter-Korean relations. President Lee said, "We must continuously expand our horizons and strive to create a structural majority. Only by consistently achieving results can that be supported; words alone won't suffice. I believe we need to harmonize these two aspects well," adding, "Fundamentally, we must conduct politics and administration that represents everyone and serves everyone." <<> Former President Moon also noted, "Another era-defining task given to the Lee Jae-myung administration is national unity," adding, "To move toward national unity, internal party unity is the starting point. The Democratic Party must unite first, and on that basis, achieve greater unity with the democratic reform camp and the forces that participated in the 'revolution of light,' only then can we gather the hearts of the people together." <<> Reporter Lee Ji-eun jieuny@hani.co.kr (문재인 전 대통령은 1일 이재명 대통령과의 회동에 대해 “만족스럽다”고 소회를 밝혔다.)

item.title: Election Commission Supports Public Verification of Songpa District Ballot Boxes with Party and Civic Group Observers (선관위 “여야·시민단체 입회하에 송파구 투표함 공개 검증 찬성”)
item.description:
The National Election Commission (NEC) announced on the 1st that it supports a plan for public verification of ballot boxes and ballots stored at Seoul’s Olympic Park in Songpa District for 26 days since the June 3 local elections, with observers from ruling and opposition parties and civic groups present. (중앙선거관리위원회가 1일 6·3 지방선거 이후 26일째 서울 송파구 올림픽공원에 보관 중인 투표함과 투표용지에 대해 여·야와 시민단체 등 입회 아래 공개 검증하는 방안에 대해 찬성 입장을 밝혔다.)

Kang Dong-wan, acting secretary-general of the NEC, said at a morning session of the National Assembly’s Special Committee on the NEC Parliamentary Investigation on the 1st, responding to a point raised by Democratic Party lawmaker Kim Yong-man about the neglected ballot boxes and ballots at the Songpa District counting station, “Currently, it is not easy to proceed with measures such as counting. The most reasonable approach would be for the special committee to deliberate on a plan to verify this in tandem with the election petition.” Kang noted that there are approximately 2.47 million ballots at the Songpa District counting station. (강동완 중앙선관위 사무총장 직무대리는 1일 오전 국회 ‘선관위 국정조사 특별위원회’(국조특위) 2차 기관보고에서 서울 송파구 개표소 내 투표함·투표용지가 방치되고 있다는 김용만 더불어민주당 의원의 지적에 대해 “현재로서는 (개표 등을) 할 수 있는 방안이 쉽지 않다. 국조특위에서 선거소청과 맞물려서 같이 확인하는 방안을 의결해 주시는 것이 가장 합리적인 방안”이라고 말했다. 강 직무대리는 송파구 개표소에는 약 247만장의 투표지가 있다고 설명했다.)

When Special Committee Chair Yoon Sang-hyun asked, “So, does this mean the special committee will decide, and then go to the site along with the election petition to publicly verify, with all ruling and opposition parties and civic groups present, that there are no issues with the ballot boxes or ballots?” Kang replied, “If you decide on that, we will proceed accordingly.” Wi Cheol-hwan, acting head of the NEC, also stated, “We are receiving official documents from the Korea Sports Association requesting cost compensation due to the prolonged protests,” adding, “We feel a sense of urgency to resolve this situation quickly.” Chairman Yoon said he would reach a conclusion on public verification through consultations between the ruling and opposition party secretaries. (윤상현 국조특위 위원장이 “국조특위에서 의결하고 선거소청과 함께 그 현장에 가서 여야, 시민단체 모두가 입회하에 투표함이나 투표지에 전혀 하자가 없다는 것을 공개 검증하겠다는 말인가”라고 묻자, 강 직무대리는 “결정해 주시면 그렇게 하겠다”고 답했다. 위철환 중앙선관위원장 직무대행도 “대한체육회 관계자들로부터 (시위 장기화에 대한) 비용 보전을 해달라는 공문을 받고 있다”며 “사태를 빨리 해소해야 한다는 위기의식을 느끼고 있다”고 했다. 윤 위원장은 여야 간사 간 협의를 통해 공개 검증 여부를 결론내겠다고 밝혔다.)

Regarding the police’s response plan to the protests blocking the Olympic Park counting station, Minister of Public Administration and Security Yoon Ho-jung said, “We have not yet decided to use force to disperse them.” When asked by Reform Party lawmaker Lee Jun-seok, “Is the Olympic Park rally an illegal protest?” Seoul Metropolitan Police Commissioner Park Jung-boo responded, “That is under review.” (올림픽공원 개표소 봉쇄 시위에 대한 경찰의 대응 계획에 대해 윤호중 행정안전부 장관은 “강제력을 동원해 해산하는 데까지 아직 판단을 못 하고 있다”고 말했다. “올림픽공원 집회가 불법 시위냐”는 이준석 개혁신당 의원의 질문에 박정보 서울경찰청장은 “검토를 하는 부분”이라고 답했다.)

On this day, both ruling and opposition parties criticized the NEC for being uncooperative in submitting documents, following its first institutional report on the 23rd of last month. Democratic Party special committee secretary Yoon Kun-young said, “During the first report, they didn’t even show up as a witness, and now they haven’t properly submitted materials, and what they did submit was a mess.” People Power Party secretary Seo Beom-soo also criticized, “We received two volumes of documents from the NEC at 6:18 p.m., after the workday ended. When we tried to contact the NEC to verify them, we only heard an automated response saying it was after work hours.” (이날 여야는 선관위가 지난달 23일 1차 기관보고에 이어 이번에도 자료 제출에 비협조적이라고 한목소리로 질타했다. 민주당 국조특위 간사인 윤건영 의원은 “1차 기관보고 때는 증인으로도 나오지 않더니 자료도 제대로 내놓지 않고 내놓은 자료도 엉망”이라고 했다. 국민의힘 간사인 서범수 의원도 “전날 일과 시간이 지난 오후 6시18분에 (선관위로부터) 2권의 자료가 왔다. 확인하기 위해 선관위에 연락하니 일과시간 후라는 자동 응답 소리만 들렸다”고 비판했다.)

On this day, the special committee agreed to conduct an on-site investigation at the Olympic Park Handball Stadium counting station in Songpa District, Seoul, where the NEC and ballot boxes are stored, at 10 a.m. on the 2nd. (이날 국조특위는 2일 오전 10시 서울 송파구 선관위와 투표함이 보관된 올림픽공원 핸드볼경기장 개표소를 직접 찾아 현장 조사하기로 의견을 모았다.)

Meanwhile, the NEC submitted improvement measures to the special committee on this day regarding the ballot shortage crisis. The measures include a plan from the second half of this year to calculate the number of printed ballots based on the principle of “100% of the number of voters according to the voter list on the date of its preparation,” with any reduction subject to approval by the Central Committee. Additionally, the plans include: introducing a full-time system for the NEC chairperson; gradually establishing a comprehensive voting management system; and reporting the audit results of the Audit Committee to the National Assembly. (한편, 선관위는 이날 투표용지 부족사태 개선 대책을 국조특위에 제출했다. 개선 대책에는 올해 하반기부터 투표용지 인쇄매수를 선거인명부 작성일 기준 ‘선거인 수의 100% 원칙’으로 산정하되, 축소하는 경우 중앙위원회 의결을 거치도록 하는 방안이 담겼다. 이밖에 △중앙선관위원장 상근제도 도입 △투표관리 종합시스템 단계적 구축 △감사위원회 감사 결과 국회 보고 등의 내용도 포함됐다.)

Reporter Kim Hae-jeong sea@hani.co.kr Reporter Jo Hee-yeon choh@hani.co.kr (김해정 기자 sea@hani.co.kr 조희연 기자 choh@hani.co.kr)

item.title: Ahn Gyu-baek: "Fierce Resistance from Vested Interests to Defense Reform for Regaining Wartime Operational Control... Even Personal Attacks on the Minister" (안규백 “‘전작권 회복’ 국방개혁에 기득권 필사 저항…장관 인신공격까지”)
item.description:
Minister of National Defense Ahn Gyu-baek emphasized the importance of retaking wartime operational control (WOC) during a meeting of key military commanders at the Ministry of National Defense in Yongsan, Seoul, on the 1st, stating, "A military that cannot make its own decisions cannot become a strong military." He underscored that after WOC is regained, when a South Korean general takes command of the Future Combined Forces Command (FCFC), which will replace the ROK-U.S. Combined Forces Command (CFC), it means that "Korea will have the authority to decide on war." (안규백 국방부 장관은 1일 서울 용산 국방부에서 열린 전군주요지휘관회의에서 “스스로 결심할 수 없는 군은 강군이 될 수 없다”며 전시작전통제권(전작권) 환수의 중요성을 강조했다. 전작권이 환수된 뒤 한미연합군사령부(연합사)를 대체할 미래연합군사령부(미래연합사)의 사령관을 한국군 대장이 맡게 되면 ‘한국이 전쟁 결정권을 갖게 된다’는 뜻을 강조한 것이다.)

In his opening remarks at the meeting, Minister Ahn said, "Regaining WOC goes beyond the notion of self-reliant defense; it is a path to building a stronger Republic of Korea and elevating the ROK-U.S. alliance to a new level. When we recover WOC, our military will fully take the lead from wartime planning and operational planning to mission execution, which will unleash the capabilities and potential our forces have accumulated over time." (안 장관은 이날 회의 머리발언에서 “전작권 회복은 자주국방이라는 수식을 넘어 더 강한 대한민국을 만들고, 한미동맹을 한 차원 더 진화시키는 길”이라며 “전작권을 회복하면 우리 군은 전시기획부터 계획수립, 작전수행까지를 온전히 주도하게 되고, 이는 우리 군이 그동안 쌓아온 역량과 잠재력을 폭발시킬 것”이라고 했다.)

Minister Ahn then urged, "I ask you to do your utmost so that, at this year's ROK-U.S. Security Consultative Meeting (SCM) in October, we can complete the Full Operational Capability (FOC) verification and report the X-year (target year) for WOC recovery." South Korea and the U.S. are pursuing the evaluation and verification of the FCFC's mission performance in three stages. The first stage, Initial Operational Capability (IOC) evaluation and verification, has been completed, and the second stage, FOC evaluation, has been conducted, with verification planned for the October SCM. Once verification is complete, the defense ministers of South Korea and the U.S. will propose the WOC transition year to the two countries' presidents. While South Korea aims for "WOC recovery within the term" of the Lee Jae-myung administration, the U.S. emphasizes meeting conditions rather than a specific timeline in the WOC transition process. (이어 안 장관은 “올해 (10월) 한미연례안보협의회(SCM)에서 완전운용능력(FOC) 검증을 마치고 전작권 회복의 (목표연도인) 엑스(X)연도를 보고드릴 수 있도록 최선을 다해주기 바란다”고 당부했다. 한·미는 미래연합사의 임무수행능력 평가·검증을 3단계로 추진하고 있다. 1단계 기본운용능력(IOC) 평가·검증을 마쳤고, 2단계인 완전운용능력(FOC) 평가를 했으며 오는 10월 한·미연례안보협의회(SCM)에서 이를 검증할 계획이다. 검증이 끝나면 한·미 국방장관은 전작권 전환연도를 양국 대통령에게 건의한다. 한국은 이재명 정부 ‘임기내 전작권 회복’을 목표로 하지만 미국은 전작권 전환 과정에서 시기보다는 조건 충족을 강조하고 있다.)

Before the commanders' meeting, Minister Ahn also chaired the 2nd WOC Recovery Promotion Evaluation Meeting, where he received reports on the progress of permanent establishment of combined component commands, including the Combined Special Operations Component Command (CSOCC). He highly praised the successful completion of the Full Mission Capability (FMC) evaluation for the CSOCC in March of this year. He urged the push for the permanent establishment of combined component commands so that, after WOC recovery, the six combined component commands can build a tightly woven combined defense posture like a network. (안 장관은 이날 지휘관회의 앞서 열린 제2차 전작권 회복 추진평가회의에서도 연합특수작전구성군사령부(연특사) 등 연합구성군사 상설화 진행사항을 보고받고, 올해 3월 연특사의 완전임무수행능력평가가 성공적으로 시행된 점을 높이 평가했다. 그는 전작권 회복 이후 6개 연합구성군 사령부가 그물망처럼 촘촘하게 연합방위태세를 구축할 수 있도록 연합구성군사령부 상설화 추진을 당부했다.)

Meanwhile, at the commanders' meeting, Minister Ahn identified three defense reform tasks that must be completed in addition to WOC recovery: educational reform at military academies, and reorganization of counterintelligence and intelligence agencies. He said, "I am once again realizing that reform is harder than revolution. Compared to a revolution that overturns the entire system, reform involves desperate resistance from vested interests and prejudices. In the face of voices at various levels, from opinions on policies to personal attacks on the minister himself, I deeply understand the heavy responsibility to weave stronger and more solid public support." (한편, 안 장관은 이날 지휘관회의에서 전작권 회복 외에도 사관학교 교육개혁, 방첩 및 정보기관 개편을 반드시 완수해야 할 세 가지 국방개혁 과제로 꼽았다. 그는 “개혁이 혁명보다 어렵다는 점을 다시 한번 절감하고 있다. 판 자체를 뒤엎는 혁명에 비해, 개혁은 기득권과 선입견의 필사적인 저항을 수반하기 때문”이라며 “정책에 대한 의견부터 장관 개인에 대한 인신공격까지 여러 층위의 목소리 앞에서, 국민의 지지를 더 두텁고 단단하게 엮어내야 할 책임이 크다는 점을 깊이 깨닫는다”고 했다.)

Reporter Kwon Hyuk-chul nura@hani.co.kr (권혁철 기자 nura@hani.co.kr)

item.title: ‘DP-led’ committee formation prompts PPP to ‘halt July extraordinary session’… conflict between ruling and opposition parties expected (‘민주 주도’ 상임위 구성에 국힘 ‘7월 임시국회 올스톱’…여야 충돌 예고)
item.description:
The People Power Party (PPP) is toying with the idea of a ‘full boycott of the National Assembly’ in response to the Democratic Party (DP)-led selection of chairpersons for 10 standing committees and the Budget and Accounts Special Committee for the second half of the parliamentary term. With the DP signaling a ‘legislative blitzkrieg’, the standoff between the ruling and opposition parties is expected to intensify. (국민의힘이 더불어민주당 주도의 국회 후반기 10개 상임위원장과 예산결산특별위원장 선출에 맞서 ‘국회 전면 보이콧’ 카드를 만지작거리고 있다. 민주당은 ‘입법 속도전’을 예고하면서 여야 간 대치가 격화할 전망이다.)

PPP Floor Leader Jeong Jeom-sik told reporters at the National Assembly on the 1st, “They have snatched away the Legislation and Judiciary Committee again, following 2024,” adding, “This is the result of the National Assembly Speaker and others siding with the tyranny of the majority party.” The previous day, the National Assembly held a plenary session, led by the DP, to elect DP lawmaker Seo Young-kyo as the chair of the Legislation and Judiciary Committee, among others. (정점식 국민의힘 원내대표는 1일 국회에서 기자들을 만나 “2024년에 이어 법제사법위원회를 강탈해 갔다”며 “국회의장 등이 다수당의 폭거에 동조한 결과”라고 했다. 전날 국회는 본회의를 열어 민주당 주도로 법제사법위원장에 서영교 민주당 의원 등을 선출했다.)

The PPP plans to hold a general meeting of lawmakers on the 2nd to discuss responses to the formation of parliamentary bodies and future strategies for struggle. They are also considering boycotting the entire schedule of the July extraordinary session. A source in the floor leadership said, “We view public opinion as unfavorable to the ruling party and will emphasize the frame of a unilateral push.” (국민의힘은 2일 의원총회를 열어 원구성 대응과 향후 투쟁 방안을 논의한다. 7월 임시국회 일정 전체를 보이콧하는 방안도 검토하고 있다. 원내 지도부 관계자는 “여론이 여당에 불리하다고 보고 독주 프레임을 강조할 것”이라고 말했다.)

However, within the party, there are voices suggesting that the PPP should accept the chair positions of the seven standing committees and continue parliamentary struggle. A second-term lawmaker said, “At best, we can secure some committee chairs that we want,” adding, “If we don’t enter the standing committees, we can’t fulfill any oversight role, so there’s not much momentum to sustain a boycott.” (하지만 당내에선 국민의힘이 7개 상임위원장 자리를 수용하고 원내 투쟁을 이어가야 한다는 목소리도 나온다. 한 재선 의원은 “일부 상임위원장이라도 우리가 원하는 곳으로 가져오는 정도가 최선”이라며 “상임위를 안 들어갈 경우 견제 역할을 전혀 할 수 없어 보이콧을 이어갈 동력이 크지 않다”고 했다.)

The DP pressured the PPP to cooperate in electing the remaining committee chairs. Acting DP Leader and Floor Leader Han Byeong-do said at a Supreme Council meeting, “With the PPP’s absurd tantrums and obstinacy, the second half of the National Assembly hasn’t even taken its first step, wasting an entire month,” and added, “We will use all means and methods to complete the normalization of the National Assembly.” Floor Leader Han also stated that they would amend the National Assembly Act to prevent the PPP’s political strife and work slowdowns. He said, “We will strengthen the standards for requesting and maintaining filibusters (unlimited debates) to ensure that even livelihood-related bills are not repeatedly taken hostage in political strife,” and added, “We will also fix the hollow fast-track system.” Filibusters are a legitimate tool for minority parties to prevent the majority from unilaterally pushing legislation, but their recent overuse has drawn criticism for straying from the spirit of the system. Considering that the maximum review period for fast-track bills (330 days) is longer than the average review period of the 21st National Assembly, the plan is to shorten it. (민주당은 남은 상임위원장 선출에 협조하라고 국민의힘을 압박했다. 한병도 민주당 대표 직무대행 겸 원내대표는 최고위원회의에서 “국민의힘의 터무니없는 몽니와 억지로 후반기 국회는 첫발을 떼지도 못한 채 한 달이란 시간을 흘려보냈다”며 “모든 수단과 방법을 동원해 국회 정상화를 완성하겠다”고 말했다. 한 원내대표는 국회법을 개정해 국민의힘의 정쟁과 태업을 막겠다고도 했다. 그는 “필리버스터(무제한 토론) 신청 및 유지 기준을 강화해 민생 법안조차 정쟁의 인질로 삼는 일이 반복되지 않도록 하겠다”며 “허울뿐인 패스트트랙(신속 처리)도 손 보겠다”고 말했다. 무제한 토론은 다수당의 일방적 입법 추진을 막기 위한 소수당의 합법적 저항 수단이지만 최근 남용되면서 제도 도입 정신에 어긋난다는 지적이 잇달았다. 패스트트랙의 최대 심사 시한(330일)이 21대 국회 평균 심사기간보다 길다는 점을 고려해 이를 단축하겠다는 방침이다.)

item.title: President Lee: "Inter-Korean Relations Will Open If You Keep Knocking Until They Open" (이 대통령 “남북관계, 열릴 때까지 두드리면 열릴 것”)
item.description:
President Lee Jae-myung expressed his commitment to improving inter-Korean relations on the 1st, stating, "We must keep knocking on North Korea's firmly bolted door. If we keep knocking, it will eventually open—won't it open if you knock until it does?" (이재명 대통령이 1일 “단단하게 빗장이 걸린 북한의 대문을 계속 두드려야 된다. 두드리면 끝까지 열릴 테고 열릴 때까지 두드리면 열리는 것 아니냐”며 남북 관계 개선 의지를 나타냈다.)

President Lee made these remarks while attending the 22nd Democratic Peaceful Unification Advisory Council's Eurasia Regional Meeting in Incheon, saying, "Who doesn't know that realizing peace on the Korean Peninsula is a complex and difficult task? But saying it's difficult doesn't mean it's impossible." Referring to his European tour last month, he added, "When I recently told European leaders that while inter-Korean relations are tough, there's a saying, 'Knock, and it shall be opened,' they responded, 'That's from the Bible.' Doesn't that show it's truth?" (이 대통령은 이날 인천에서 열린 제22기 민주평화통일자문회의 유라시아 지역회의에 참석해 “한반도 평화 실현이 복잡하고 어려운 과제인 거 누가 모르겠냐. 그러나 어렵다는 말이 결코 불가능하다는 것은 아니다”라며 이렇게 말했다. 이 대통령은 지난달 유럽 순방을 언급하며 “얼마 전 유럽 정상들한테 남북 관계가 어렵지만, ‘두드려라, 그러면 열릴 것이다’라는 말도 있다고 하니 (정상들이) ‘그거 성경에 나오는 말인데’라고 얘기하더라”며 “그만큼 진리라는 뜻 아니겠냐”고 말했다.)

President Lee also repeatedly emphasized that he has no intention of pursuing absorption-style unification with North Korea. He said, "Since taking office, I have consistently declared that we will respect North Korea's system, not pursue absorption unification, and not engage in any hostile acts. I will keep this promise without fail." He continued, "Now, we will restart actions toward peace. We will surely find a path for the South and the North to respect each other's systems and sovereignty and coexist peacefully. Even if it's slow, we will never give up." (이 대통령은 거듭 북한과 흡수 통일을 할 의사가 없다는 점도 강조했다. 이 대통령은 “저는 취임 이후에 일관되게 ‘북의 체제를 존중하겠다’, ‘흡수 통일을 추진하지 않겠다’, ‘일체의 적대 행위도 하지 않겠다’ 이렇게 공언해왔다”며 “이 약속을 반드시 지킬 것”이라고 말했다. 이어 “이제 평화를 향한 행동을 다시 시작할 것”이라며 “남과 북이 서로의 체제와 주권을 존중하고 평화롭게 공존하는 길을 반드시 찾아내겠다. 더디더라도 결코 포기하지 않겠다”고 말했다.)

President Lee stated, "To open the era of the Korea Premium for our peninsula's future, which the whole world is watching, we must transform the armistice regime into a peace regime. If the South and the North now stop hostility and confrontation and achieve peace together, I am confident that we can achieve greater results than ever before." (이 대통령은 “전세계가 주목하는 우리 한반도의 미래 코리아 프리미엄 시대를 열어가기 위해서라도 우리는 반드시 정전 체제를 평화 체제로 바꿔내야 한다”며 “남과 북이 이제는 적대와 대결을 멈추고 함께 평화를 이루어낸다면 우리는 과거 그 어느 때에도 이루지 못한 더 큰 성과를 이뤄낼 수 있을 것이라고 확신한다”고 말했다.)

Reporter Go Gyeong-ju goh@hani.co.kr (고경주 기자 goh@hani.co.kr)

item.title: Democratic Party Takes Over Legislation and Judiciary Committee, Speeds Up Legislation to Abolish Supplementary Investigative Powers (법사위 꿰찬 민주당, ‘보완수사권 폐지’ 입법 속도 높인다)
item.description:
The Democratic Party of Korea has indicated its intent to accelerate the revision of the Criminal Procedure Act regarding the abolition of supplementary investigative powers. President Lee Jae-myung on the 1st urged party leadership, including acting party leader and floor leader Han Byeong-do, to speed up the legislation process during a dinner meeting at the presidential office Cheong Wa Dae. (더불어민주당이 보완수사권 폐지를 둘러싼 형사소송법 개정 작업에 속도를 내겠다는 뜻을 밝혔다. 이재명 대통령은 1일 한병도 당대표 직무대행 겸 원내대표를 포함한 민주당 원내대표단과 청와대에서 만찬을 함께하면서 입법에 속도를 내달라고 당부했다.)

Floor leader Han Byeong-do stated at a Supreme Council meeting at the National Assembly that day, "We will swiftly finalize the revision of the Criminal Procedure Act, the last piece of the puzzle for prosecutorial reform," adding, "There is a public consensus on separating investigation and prosecution, and the party, government, and presidential office are united in purpose. The floor leadership, policy committee, and members of the Legislation and Judiciary Committee will begin full-fledged work on the revision." Han further noted, "We will pool our wisdom to create a single proposal and conclude the legislation quickly through intense discussion and deliberation." This comes after the Democratic Party-led election of lawmaker Seo Young-kyo as chair of the National Assembly's Legislation and Judiciary Committee at the previous plenary session, signaling an effort to finalize the amendment. ( 한병도 원내대표는 이날 국회 최고위원회의에서 “검찰개혁의 마지막 퍼즐인 형사소송법 개정을 신속하게 마무리하겠다”며 “수사와 기소의 분리에는 국민적 공감대가 형성돼 있고, 당·정·청도 한마음 한뜻이다. 원내 지도부와 정책위, 법사위원들은 형사소송법 개정 작업에 본격적으로 착수하겠다”고 말했다. 한 원내대표는 “지혜를 모아 단일안을 만들고 치열한 토론과 숙의를 거쳐 빠른 시간 안에 입법을 마무리하겠다”고 덧붙였다. 전날 국회 본회의에서 민주당 주도로 서영교 의원이 국회 법제사법위원장으로 선출된 만큼 형사소송법 개정을 매듭짓겠다는 것이다.)

The Democratic Party is leaning toward completing the revision of the Criminal Procedure Act before its August 17th national convention. A floor leadership source told The Hankyoreh, "There is no thought of delaying it until after the convention," and added, "We have already aligned on the direction to abolish supplementary investigative powers, and there are no differences in stance among the convention contenders, so handling it before the convention won't be seen as favoring or disfavoring any specific candidate." Legislation and Judiciary Committee chair Seo Young-kyo said, "It typically takes about six months to draft enforcement decrees or detailed guidelines, and that period has long passed," and added, "If we can handle it quickly, even before the convention, we intend to do so." ( 민주당은 8·17 전당대회 전에 형사소송법 개정을 마무리하겠다는 기류가 강하다. 원내지도부 관계자는 한겨레에 “전당대회 후로 미뤄야 한다는 생각은 없다”며 “이미 보완수사권 폐지로 방향을 모았고, (전당대회 당권 주자 간) 입장차가 있는 것도 아니어서 전당대회 전에 처리하더라도 특정 후보에게 유리하거나 불리하다고 해석될 여지가 없다”고 했다. 서영교 법사위원장은 “시행령이나 세부 지침 등을 만들려면 통상 6개월이 필요한데 (그 시기가) 한참 지나갔다”며 “전당대회 전이라도 빨리 처리할 수 있으면 하려고 한다”고 했다.)

Meanwhile, President Lee invited floor leader Han Byeong-do and other floor leadership members to Cheong Wa Dae's State Guest House for a dinner that day. ( 한편, 이 대통령은 이날 한 원내대표를 포함한 원내대표단을 청와대 영빈관으로 초청해 만찬을 함께했다.)

Floor spokesperson Lee Joo-hee reported that President Lee said, "It's been a while since I met colleagues who crossed the line," and urged, "Please speed up the handling of legislative bills related to state tasks in the second half of the year." Han Byeong-do responded, "We will strongly support success through necessary legislation," and the floor leadership also stated, "In the second year of the administration, the government and ruling party will unite more firmly to create a turning point for the development of the people's livelihood economy." ( 이 대통령은 “사선을 넘어온 동료들을 오랜만에 만났다”며 “하반기에는 국정 과제 관련 입법안 처리에 더욱 속도를 내달라”고 말했다고 이주희 원내대변인이 전했다. 이에 한 원내대표는 “필요한 입법으로 강력히 성공을 뒷받침하겠다”고 답했고, 원내대표단도 “집권 2년차에는 정부와 여당이 더 단단히 단합해 민생경제 발전의 전기를 마련하겠다”고 뜻을 밝혔다.)

Reporter Go Han-sol sol@hani.co.kr (고한솔 기자 sol@hani.co.kr)

item.title: President Lee and Former President Moon: "Derogatory nicknames are unhelpful"…Emphasizing Democratic Party unity (이 대통령-문 전 대통령 “멸칭 도움 안돼”…민주당 단합 강조)
item.description:
President Lee Jae-myung and former President Moon Jae-in shared a lunch at the Blue House on the 1st, emphasizing unity within the democratic camp, stating that "hurting others with fake news or derogatory nicknames is not helpful to anyone." Ahead of the August 17 Democratic Party of Korea national convention, as factional conflicts deepen over debates on legitimate succession, they delivered a message of harmony. (이재명 대통령과 문재인 전 대통령이 1일 청와대에서 오찬을 함께하며 “가짜뉴스나 멸칭으로 상처 입히는 것은 어느 누구에게도 도움되지 않는다”며 민주 진영 단합을 강조했다. 8·17 더불어민주당 전당대회를 앞두고 적통 논쟁 등으로 계파 갈등이 심화하는 가운데 화합의 메시지를 낸 것이다.)

President Lee invited former President Moon to the Blue House for a two-hour lunch that day. This was the first time the two had a meal together at the Blue House since President Lee took office. (이 대통령은 이날 문재인 전 대통령을 청와대로 초청해 2시간 동안 오찬을 했다. 두 사람이 청와대에서 오찬을 한 것은 이 대통령 취임 뒤 처음이다.)

The two agreed on the need for harmony and unity within the party. (두 사람은 당내 화합과 통합에 공감했다.)

Former President Moon said, "Another era-defining task given to the Lee Jae-myung administration is national unity," adding, "The Democratic Party must first unite, and on top of that, achieve greater unity with the democratic reform camp and the forces that were part of the revolution of light, only then can we gather the hearts of the people." In response, President Lee said, "We must take power and practice politics for everyone. Internal unity is also very important. We must continuously expand our reach and strive to create a structural majority." (문 전 대통령은 “이재명 정부에 주어진 또 하나의 시대적 과제는 국민 통합”이라며 “민주당이 먼저 단합하고 그 위에 민주 개혁 진영, 그리고 빛의 혁명을 함께했던 세력과의 더 큰 단합을 이뤄내야 국민의 마음을 하나로 모을 수 있다”고 말했다. 이에 이 대통령은 “우리가 집권해 모두를 위한 정치를 해야 한다”며 “내부의 단합도 매우 중요하다. 끊임없이 외연을 확장하고 구조적 다수를 만들기 위해 노력해야 한다”고 말했다.)

After the lunch meeting, Senior Presidential Secretary for Political Affairs Hong Ik-pyo said, "The two have agreed to join forces for the sake of a single Republic of Korea," adding, "They shared the understanding that to generate more national achievements and lead to changes felt by the people, unity within the democratic camp is desperately needed, and we must move toward national unity." In particular, Senior Secretary Hong said, "The two agreed that hurting others with fake news or derogatory nicknames is not helpful to anyone," and "They discussed that overly aggressive expressions or mocking derogatory nicknames can wound each other's hearts, so while competition is possible, it could make it difficult to work together later." This sent a clear signal that former and current presidents from the Democratic Party should not allow the situation, where leading contenders engage in heated debates over legitimate succession and harshly criticize each other ahead of the upcoming Democratic Party national convention, to continue any longer. (홍익표 청와대 정무수석은 오찬 회동 뒤 “두 분은 하나의 대한민국을 위해 함께 힘을 모으기로 했다”며 “더 많은 국정 성과를 창출하고 국민이 체감하는 변화로 이어지려면 민주 진영의 단합이 절실하고, 국민 통합으로 나아가야 한다는 데 공감하고 함께 노력하기로 했다”고 말했다. 특히 홍 수석은 “두 분은 가짜뉴스나 멸칭으로 상처 입히는 것은 어느 누구에게도 도움되지 않는다고 뜻을 모았다”며 “지나치게 공격적인 표현이나 조롱 섞인 멸칭은 서로 마음에 상처를 입히기 때문에 경쟁은 할 수 있지만 나중에 함께하는 데 어려움을 줄 수 있다는 말씀을 나누셨다”고 말했다. 민주당 출신 전현직 대통령이 최근 민주당 전당대회를 앞두고 유력 주자들 간에 적통 논쟁을 벌이면서 상대를 원색적으로 비난하는 상황이 더는 이어져선 안 된다고 명확한 신호를 보낸 것이다.)

Regarding the meeting between President Lee and former President Moon, the leading contenders for the national convention—former Prime Minister Kim Min-seok, former Party Leader Jung Cheong-rae, and lawmaker Song Young-gil—unanimously stated that they would "strive for unity, integration, and expanding our reach." (이 대통령과 문 전 대통령의 회동에 대해 전대 유력 주자인 김민석 전 총리와 정청래 전 대표, 송영길 의원은 일제히 “단합과 통합, 외연 확장을 위해 노력하겠다”는 뜻을 밝혔다.)

Reporter Goh Kyung-joo goh@hani.co.kr (고경주 기자 goh@hani.co.kr)

item.title: Kim Min-seok "Is There a Need for a Second Term as Leader?" ... Jeong Cheong-rae's Side "Both Prime Minister and Party Leader?" (김민석 “대표 2번 할 필요 있나”…정청래 쪽 “총리하고 대표까지?”)
item.description:
On his first day back to the party, former Prime Minister Kim Min-seok sharpened his criticism toward former leader Jeong Cheong-rae, a potential rival in the upcoming August 17 Democratic Party of Korea convention, saying, "It is hard to see the need for (the party leadership) to be done twice in the way Jeong has done it." The two also engaged in a war of words over the issue of integrating the Democratic Party and the Rebuilding Korea Party. (김민석 전 국무총리가 당 복귀 첫날인 1일 “정청래 전 대표가 지금까지 방식으로 (당대표직을) 두번 할 필요는 발견하기 어렵다”며 8·17 더불어민주당 전당대회 잠재 경쟁자인 정 전 대표를 향해 날을 세웠다. 김 전 총리와 정 전 대표는 민주당과 조국혁신당 통합 문제를 두고도 신경전을 벌였다.)

On this day, after the prime minister's farewell ceremony, Kim visited the Democratic Party's central office in Yeouido, Seoul, the main building of the National Assembly, the Sotong Hall, and the lawmakers' office building to greet supporters upon his return. In a post on X (formerly Twitter), he wrote, "Again! I will definitely create a winning Democratic Party and support the success of state affairs." Kim has secured an election campaign office in Yeouido for the party convention and has begun full-scale operations of his camp. Rep. Yeom Tae-young will serve as the general situation room chief, Rep. Kim Tae-seon as the chief of staff, and Rep. Lee Yong-woo as the media response lead. (김 전 총리는 이날 총리 이임식 뒤 서울 여의도 민주당 중앙당과 국회 본청, 소통관, 의원회관 등을 찾아 복귀 인사를 했다. 그는 엑스(X·옛 트위터)에 올린 글을 통해 “다시! 이기는 민주당! 반드시 만들어 국정 성공을 뒷받침하겠다”고 썼다. 김 전 총리는 여의도에 전당대회 선거 사무실을 구하고 캠프 가동도 본격화했다. 종합상황실장은 염태영 의원이, 비서실장 역할은 김태선 의원이, 언론 대응은 이용우 의원이 맡는다.)

In an interview with OhmyNews released on this day, Kim fired a direct shot at Jeong's bid for a consecutive term as leader, asking, "Is there a need to extend Jeong's leadership?" He added, "Now is the time for leadership with a different color, capability, style, and strengths compared to Jeong." Regarding author Yoo Si-min's theory of reconstruction, Kim stressed, "I believe that with that approach, it is impossible to achieve the democratic forces' governance, success in state affairs, election victory, or continued hold on power, so I cannot yield or compromise. We must embrace rational reform, progressives, conservatives, and centrists alike." (김 전 총리는 이날 공개된 오마이뉴스 인터뷰 등에서 “정 전 대표 체제가 연장될 필요가 있느냐”며 정 전 대표의 대표직 연임 도전에 직격탄을 날렸다. 그는 “이제는 정 전 대표와 다른 색깔, 역량, 스타일, 장점을 가진 리더십이 필요한 때”라고 덧붙였다. 김 전 총리는 유시민 작가의 재건축론에 대해서도 “그렇게 해서는 민주 세력의 국정 운영도, 국정 성공도, 총선 승리도, 집권 연속도 불가능하다고 보기 때문에 양보하고 타협할 수 없다”며 “합리적 개혁, 진보, 보수, 중도를 다 끌어안아야 한다”고 강조했다.)

Kim also pointed out the failure of the merger process, saying, "I think the process of handling the merger (with the Rebuilding Korea Party, in January and February) was mishandled, leading to the failure." Additionally, he addressed his past move to the People's Unity 21 party during the 2002 presidential election, when there were calls within the Democratic Party for a unification between candidate Roh Moo-hyun of the Millennium Democratic Party and candidate Chung Mong-joon of People's Unity 21 (the "post-unification committee" incident). In an interview on JTBC's 'Lee Ga-hyuk Live,' Kim said, "In President Roh Moo-hyun's autobiography, which he authored and Yoo Si-min reviewed, it was clearly stated that 'what happened back then was done out of loyalty to recreate the government, was a reasonable judgment, and the results turned out that way, but it put (former Prime Minister Kim) in a difficult position.' That's how he summarized it." (김 전 총리는 “(정 전 대표가 지난 1~2월 조국혁신당과) 합당을 풀어가는 과정이 잘못돼 일을 그르쳤다고 본다”며 합당이 무산된 점을 지적하기도 했다. 아울러 그는 2002년 대선 때 노무현 새천년민주당 후보와 정몽준 국민통합21 후보 간 단일화 요구가 민주당 내부에서 나오던 당시 자신이 국민통합21로 옮겼던 일(후단협 사태)에 대한 입장도 내놨다. 김 전 총리는 제이티비시(JTBC) ‘이가혁 라이브’ 인터뷰에서 “당사자인 노무현 대통령께서 집필하고 유시민 작가가 감수한 (노 전 대통령) 자서전에 ‘그 당시 일은 정권 재창출을 위해 충정에서 한 것이고 합리적 판단이고 결과도 그렇게 됐는데 본인(김 전 총리)은 어렵게 됐다’ 딱 이렇게 정리를 해주신 바 있다”고 말했다.)

Meanwhile, on this day, Jeong visited Jeonju, North Jeolla Province, to attend the inauguration ceremony of Governor Lee Won-taek at the Provincial Government Office. He emphasized to reporters, "Within the Democratic Party, supporters of former Presidents Kim Dae-jung, Roh Moo-hyun, and Moon Jae-in must unite for a grand integration." Jeong's visit to North Jeolla Province was accompanied by Reps. Choi Min-hee and Im O-kyung. Rep. Choi posted on Facebook, "When Kim asks whether Jeong really needs to be leader twice, I wonder: Does a former prime minister really need to become party leader?"—criticizing Kim. (이런 가운데 정 전 대표는 이날 전북 전주를 찾아 전북도청에서 열린 이원택 전북지사 취임식에 참석했다. 그는 기자들에게 “민주당 안에서 김대중·노무현·문재인 전 대통령 지지자들이 하나로 모이는 대통합을 이뤄야 한다”고 강조했다. 정 전 대표의 전북 방문에는 최민희, 임오경 의원 등이 함께했다. 최 의원은 페이스북에 글을 올려 “김 전 총리가 정 전 대표에게 굳이 대표를 두번 할 필요가 있냐고 물었다는데 궁금하다. 총리 하다가 굳이 당대표를 할 필요는 있느냐”며 김 전 총리를 비판했다.)

During the governor's inauguration ceremony, Jeong mentioned Samsung Electronics' and SK Hynix's semiconductor cluster investments in South Jeolla Province and Gwangju, appealing to the sentiments of residents in North Jeolla Province, which was not included in the government's three major mega-project announcements. "We will work our hardest so that no one feels left out or a sense of loss," he said. A multi-term lawmaker from the Seoul metropolitan area remarked, "Competition for the party convention is fine, but concerns are growing day by day that the process may divide party members and factions, deepening rifts through conflict." (정 전 대표가 이 지사 취임식 중 전남·광주 삼성전자·에스케이(SK)하이닉스 반도체 클러스터 투자를 언급하며 “소외감, 상실감 느끼지 않도록 최선을 다해 일하겠다”며 정부 3대 메가프로젝트 발표 지역에 포함되지 않은 전북 민심에 호소하기도 했다. 한 수도권 다선 의원은 “전당대회 경쟁도 좋지만 그 과정에서 당원과 진영 내부가 양분되고 서로 다투며 골이 깊어질 우려가 나날이 커지고 있다”고 말했다.)

Reporters Choi Ha-yan chy@hani.co.kr and Ko Han-sol sol@hani.co.kr (최하얀 기자 chy@hani.co.kr 고한솔 기자 sol@hani.co.kr)

item.title: Baejae High School's 'Starbucks Cheer' Draws Heavy Penalty: Na Kyung-won 'Deplores', Jeong Jeom-sik 'Excessive' (‘스벅 응원가’ 배재고 중징계에…나경원 “개탄” 정점식 “과도”)
item.description:
The People Power Party (PPP) criticized the decision to ban Baejae High School's baseball team, which stirred controversy by chanting 'Starbucks' cheers toward Gwangju Jeil High School, from national competitions for six months, calling it an 'excessive measure' and urging a reconsideration. <<> Floor leader Jeong Jeom-sik said on Facebook that day: "For young athletes, participation in national competitions is a matter of advancing to college and their entire baseball career. Not all Baejae High School players committed the wrongdoing, and many players did not join in the mockery. A six-month ban from competitions for the entire baseball team is excessive." He added: "Even though we have the responsibility to educate and guide, we do not have the right to crush their dreams. I earnestly ask the Korea Baseball Softball Association (KBSA) to reconsider the suspension." <<> Lawmaker Na Kyung-won remarked: "Is this truly appropriate? They took away the freedom to go to Starbucks, and now they take away children's dreams? This is the shameful face of the Republic of Korea under the Lee Jae-myung regime. I am deploring it." Lawmaker Kim Jae-seop also pointed out on Facebook: "The behavior of Baejae High School players, who made a mockery of the May 18 Democratic Uprising, is despicable and cannot be excused. However, the weight of criticism directed at them is abnormally heavy. Just a while ago, the entire government, led by the president, was attacking Starbucks. Now, the Minister of Education and politicians are all joining in to witch-hunt the Baejae High School players." <<> Earlier, on the 29th, some Baejae High School players chanted the slogan 'We should go to Starbucks' toward the dugout of their opponent, Gwangju Jeil High School, during the Cheongryonggi National High School Baseball Championship held at Mokdong Stadium in Seoul, sparking controversy. In response, the Korea Baseball Softball Association (KBSA) imposed a heavy penalty of a six-month ban from national competitions. <<> Reporter Ko Kyung-ju goh@hani.co.kr (국민의힘이 1일 광주제일고를 향해 ‘스타벅스’ 응원을 해 논란이 된 배재고 야구부가 6개월 전국대회 출전 정지 징계를 받은 데 대해 ‘과한 조처’라고 비판하며 재고를 촉구했다.)

item.title: President Lee and Former President Moon Call for "Unity Within the Democratic Party"... Will the Convention Conflict Be Resolved? (이 대통령·문 전 대통령 “민주당 내 단합”…전대 갈등 수습될까)
item.description:
President Lee Jae-myung and former President Moon Jae-in jointly emphasized "unity" within the Democratic Party of Korea during a lunch meeting on the 1st, driven by a perceived need to mend the overheated and divisive atmosphere surrounding the August 17th party convention. With a structure emerging where the pro-Lee faction appears to support former Prime Minister Kim Min-seok and the pro-Moon faction seems to back former Representative Jeong Cheong-rae, attention is focused on whether this meeting between the current and former presidents will become a turning point for resolving the conflict. (이재명 대통령과 문재인 전 대통령이 1일 함께한 오찬에서 더불어민주당 내 ‘단합’을 한목소리로 강조한 것은, 8·17 민주당 전당대회가 과열돼 분열 양상을 띠는 것을 봉합할 필요성을 느꼈기 때문이다. 당내 친이재명(친명)계는 김민석 전 국무총리를, 친문재인(친문)계는 정청래 전 대표를 지지하는 듯한 구도가 형성된 가운데 두 전현직 대통령의 만남이 갈등 수습의 변곡점이 될지 주목된다.)

During his opening remarks at the lunch held at the presidential office, former President Moon stated, "President Lee is the only person in South Korea capable of achieving the Democratic Party's unity, greater unity with the democratic reform camp, and even national integration." He added, "I hope you will exercise greater leadership and surely realize the dream of becoming everyone's president." In response, President Lee said, "Internal unity is important, and we must constantly strive to expand our external reach to build structural majorities. We need to harmonize both aspects well." These remarks could be interpreted as former President Moon placing weight on "internal unity," while President Lee focused on "expanding external reach." <<> Regarding this, the presidential office explained that the two concepts are not separate. Chief Political Secretary Hong Ik-pyo, in a briefing at the Chungham Pavilion after the meeting, stated, "It means that only through unity can external expansion be possible, and only by expanding externally while uniting can a democratic government succeed." He added, "The two agreed that we must not act aggressively or insultingly toward each other." According to Democratic Party Rep. Yoon Geon-young, former President Moon, before heading back to his residence in Pyeongsan Village, Yangsan, South Gyeongsang Province, after the meeting, said, "It was a satisfactory meeting. We had a candid and open conversation about overall state affairs. Compared to when I came up to Seoul, I feel much more at ease now heading down to Pyeongsan." <<> The message from the current and former presidents is seen as expressing concern over the internal party conflict, which has escalated into an emotional fight ahead of the convention. <<> Recently, on online communities, Democratic Party supporters have been dividing themselves, creating derogatory terms that lump key figures from the pro-Lee and pro-Moon factions and exchanging mutual criticism. Additionally, the party leadership contenders and key figures have "entered" the debate over political legitimacy. After former Rep. Jeong Cheong-rae promoted himself as a "Roh Moo-hyun kid," Rep. Song Young-gil brought up claims that Rep. Jeong did not attend former President Roh's funeral and subsequently apologized. Author Yoo Si-min also appeared on Kim Eo-joon's YouTube channel on the 26th of last month and criticized President Lee's stance on external expansion, stating, "President Lee seems to be trying to do a reconstruction (not the expansion supporters wanted)." Following this, a series of polls indicated a decline in approval ratings for President Lee and the ruling party. It is against this backdrop that the current and former presidents, who had not had a meeting at the presidential office for over a year, met and emphasized "unity." <<> Major contenders for the Democratic Party leadership responded positively to the message from the current and former presidents. Former Prime Minister Kim wrote on his X account, "Even when fighting an opponent, dignity is needed, so much more so among comrades. Respect and restraint are internal traditions that have run through the eras of Kim Dae-jung, Roh Moo-hyun, Moon Jae-in, and Lee Jae-myung. They need to be restored." Former Rep. Jeong, meeting with reporters before the inauguration ceremony for Governor Lee Won-taek at the North Jeolla Provincial Office, said, "Within the Democratic Party, we must achieve grand unity, bringing supporters of former Presidents Kim Dae-jung, Roh Moo-hyun, and Moon Jae-in together. Further expanding our external reach is the path the Democratic Party must take to reclaim power." Rep. Song Young-gil also wrote on Facebook, "I believe that creating results through unity and expansion and proving them with those results to build a 'true ruling party' is the way to respond to the two former leaders' advice." <<> Rep. Kim Nam-jun said in a phone call with The Hankyoreh, "There is growing fatigue with the way people attack each other by bringing up the past, so it seems the two presidents sent a message against division." A first-term lawmaker commented, "We need to stop backward-looking negativity and compete on 'truly performing well' as the ruling party." However, many around the party predict it will not be easy to stop the competition for the party leadership, as the stakes involve nominations for the general election two years from now, and the race is already heating up. <<> Meanwhile, President Lee and former President Moon also exchanged views on issues such as prosecution reform and inter-Korean relations. <<> Chief Secretary Hong stated, "Regarding prosecution reform, which is a very important government reform task, they agreed that it is crucial for ensuring the democratization of our society and preventing the abuse of power by the prosecution in the future. Former President Moon said, 'While acting quickly is important, the government should push forward more carefully and meticulously to prevent harm or adverse effects on the people.'" Former President Moon advised on inter-Korean relations that "If we knock on the door for dialogue, opportunities will arise again." President Lee expressed frustration, saying, "I feel the inter-Korean relationship has been broken beyond repair. Yoon Seok-yeol's government's military pressure on the North for the sake of a self-coup was truly excessive." He added, "I will continue the policies for inter-Korean peaceful coexistence, starting from the Sunshine Policy that democratic governments have pursued." (문 전 대통령은 이날 청와대에서 열린 오찬 머리발언에서 “민주당의 단합, 민주개혁 진영과의 더 큰 단합, 그리고 국민 통합까지 나아갈 일을 해낼 수 있는 사람이 대한민국에서는 이 대통령뿐”이라며 “더 큰 리더십을 발휘하셔서 모두의 대통령이라는 꿈을 반드시 이루시길 바란다”고 말했다. 이에 이 대통령은 “내부 단합도 중요하고, 끊임없이 외연을 확장해 구조적 다수를 만들기 위해 노력해야 한다. 두가지를 잘 조화롭게 해야 한다”고 말했다. 문 전 대통령은 ‘내부 단합’에, 이 대통령은 ‘외연 확장’에 무게를 둔 듯한 뉘앙스로 풀이할 수도 있는 발언이었다.)

Reporter Seo Young-ji yj@hani.co.kr Reporter Kim Chae-woon cwk@hani.co.kr (이에 대해 청와대는 두가지가 별개가 아니라고 설명했다. 홍익표 청와대 정무수석은 회동 뒤 춘추관 브리핑에서 “단합을 해야 외연 확장이 가능하고, 외연 확장을 하면서 단합해야만 민주 정부가 성공할 수 있다는 뜻”이라며 “서로에게 공격적이거나 모욕적 방식으로 하면 안 된다는 데 두분이 뜻을 같이했다”고 덧붙였다. 문 대통령은 회동 뒤 사저가 있는 경남 양산시 평산마을로 향하기 전 “만족스러운 회동이었다. 국정 전반에 관해 허심탄회하게 이야기를 나눴다. 서울에 올라올 때보다 평산으로 내려가는 지금, 한결 마음이 놓인다”고 말했다고 윤건영 민주당 의원이 전했다.)

item.title: Palestinian Child Bana's Drawings, Who Hates School and Homework, Cross War and Division (학교와 숙제를 싫어하는 팔레스타인 어린이 ‘바나’의 그림, 전쟁과 분단을 넘다)
item.description:
"Coming to the Korean Peninsula, I feel a much stronger sense of kinship than when I went to other countries." <<> Tasameh Ramadan, director of the civic group 'Sij' which provides youth community education in Palestine, met with The Hankyoreh at the National Assembly on the 25th and cited war and division as commonalities between the situations facing South Korea and Palestine. Director Tasameh attended the exhibition of 'Drawing Hope', an international peace project where children from conflict zones like Palestine draw pictures, held that day at the National Assembly Members' Office Building by the North Korea aid organization 'Friends of Children'. <<> She said, "Just like separated families in Korea, it is common in Palestine for families to be separated by barriers and checkpoints." Israel occupies the West Bank and has erected separation barriers in many places, citing the need to 'protect Israeli citizens from terrorism'. <<> Director Tasameh calmly recounted the bleak reality of Palestinians who must check on their families' well-being through their fingertips. "There is a mother and daughter among my neighbors who live apart, separated by a wall. They try to find cracks or small holes in the wall to touch each other, even if just with their fingers," she said. It is said that Palestinians who have become separated families due to such barriers wander looking for holes in the wall, hoping for even a 'fingertip reunion'. She found this scene similar to the Demilitarized Zone (DMZ) on the divided Korean Peninsula, the barbed wire, separated families, and the severance of free movement. While the causes and forms of war and division experienced by South Korea and Palestine differ, she said they are alike in that people cannot meet those they want to, and tension and hostility are a part of daily life. <<> Palestine Youth Community Education
Teaching Survival Skills Like First Aid
'Through Gunfire, Checkpoints, and Separation from Family,
Children Accumulate Layers of Isolation and Frustration' <<> War brutally cuts away even the childhood memories of Palestinian people. As children grow up, they experience Israeli checkpoints, gunfire, and separation from family. Director Tasameh said, "Palestinians must have the ability to remain calm and provide first aid to a wounded friend if they are walking down the road and suddenly Israeli soldiers open fire." So 'Sij' also teaches youth emergency training like first aid and responding to explosives. In a Palestinian reality where no one knows when gunfire will start or when infrastructure will collapse, such preparation has become a survival skill. <<> Director Tasameh described the hardest aspect for Palestinian children as "a life robbed of childhood." She said that when she first went abroad at age 14, she was shocked that there were no checkpoints when moving between cities. "In Palestine, I thought it was natural that you had to pass through a checkpoint to go anywhere," she said. As time passes, the wounds, frustration, and isolation of Palestinian children accumulate in layers, but the urgency of surviving in Palestine means that caring for these children's trauma and healing their minds is always pushed aside. <<> Director Tasameh explained that the very process of Palestinian children participating in the 'Drawing Hope' project—drawing pictures on the theme of 'hope' and expressing their suppressed emotions while receiving empathy—was the beginning of healing. What was particularly impressive was the way solidarity was created through the drawings. The children asked questions like "Do Korean people know about us?" and "Are we not alone?", and they felt great significance in being connected to the world through their drawings. She said, "While protest rallies supporting Palestine are also important, children's drawings appeal to the heart more directly." <<> Hosted by North Korea Aid Group Friends of Children
Participating in an Exhibition of Conflict Zone Children's Drawings
'Connection to the World Through Drawings Holds Great Meaning' <<> Kim Dong-jin, director of Friends of Children, who interpreted the interview that day, said, "Drawing Hope continuously asks us, 'In an era where war and division have become routine, how can people live together in harmony?' When we empathize with the pain of people in other regions and encounter our shared humanity through the eyes of children, we gain new imagination and hope regarding our own social reality." <<> In the frank greeting from 11-year-old Palestinian child Bana, whose drawing was displayed in 'Drawing Hope'—"I really hate school and homework"—adults are confronted with how threadbare the garment of division they wear truly is. <<> Lee Ki-bum, chairman of Friends of Children, emphasized the significance of the event, where children send messages to friends in societies with different histories of conflict through their drawings, saying, "Children are trying to overcome the walls of war and conflict that adults have created, through drawings of peace." After the exhibition at the National Assembly, the children's drawings will be displayed at Imjingak, Gyeonggi Province, until the 31st of this month. <<> The Drawing Hope exhibition originated from Friends of Children's inter-Korean children's drawing exchange project. Since 1996, Friends of Children has been facilitating activities where North and South Korean children, unable to meet due to division, draw and exchange self-portraits. These activities expanded to East Asia, including Japan and China, and developed into the 'East Asian Children's Peace Drawing Exhibition' starting in 2001. Later, through solidarity from around the world that resonated with messages of courage and peace, it expanded in 2023 into Drawing Hope, with children from various countries participating. Exhibitions have been held in Los Angeles, USA (2023), Belfast, Northern Ireland (2024), and Cape Town, South Africa (last year). <<> For the past 30 years, Friends of Children has strived to create a Korean Peninsula where children from North and South can play together, arm-in-arm. To walk arm-in-arm, one needs similar height and mutual understanding. Friends of Children conducts peace education so that children in the South can grow up peacefully, and provides humanitarian aid and inter-Korean cooperation activities so that children in the North can grow up healthy and walk arm-in-arm at the same height. <<> Director Tasameh asked young South Koreans to "move beyond accepting division as a natural reality and recognize the structure that creates it." She concluded the interview by saying to young South Koreans, "Come visit Palestine." It was a wish for a peaceful era to come soon, where young South Koreans can travel to Palestine. <<> Text and photos by reporter Kwon Hyuk-chul nura@hani.co.kr (“다른 나라를 갔을 때보다 한반도에 오니 훨씬 동질감을 많이 느낍니다.”)

item.description:

item.title: Na Kyung-won Says Among Judiciary Committee Chairs, "Choo Mi-ae Is Better, Nation Disliked Her" (나경원, 법사위원장 중엔 “추미애가 나아, 국민 비호감이라”)
item.description:
People Power Party lawmaker Na Kyung-won stated that among recent Democratic Party lawmakers who have served as the chair of the National Assembly's Legislation and Judiciary Committee, Gyeonggi Province Governor Choo Mi-ae is "rather better." (나경원 국민의힘 의원이 근래 국회 법제사법위원장을 맡은 더불어민주당 의원들 가운데 추미애 경기도지사가 “차라리 낫다”고 밝혔다.)

Speaking on SBS Radio's "Kim Tae-hyun's Political Show" on the 2nd, Na expressed outrage over the Democratic Party recently taking 11 of the 18 standing committee chair positions. "I think the National Assembly should be dissolved. We're completely the opposition's sidekicks. They're passing bills as they please," Na said. "They're asking us to play the role of accessories for whatever they want to do." (나 의원은 2일 에스비에스(SBS) 라디오 ‘김태현의 정치쇼’에 나와 최근 민주당이 상임위 18개 가운데 11개의 상임위원장을 맡게 된 점 등을 두고 분개했다. 나 의원은 “저는 국회 해산해야 한다고 본다. 완전히 우리가 야당 들러리다. 자기들 마음대로 법안 다 통과되는 것”이라며 “자기들 하고 싶은 거에 (야당이) 액세서리 역할을 하라는 거 아니냐”고 했다.)

Regarding lawmaker Seo Young-kyo, who was elected chair of the Judiciary Committee the previous day, Na evaluated that "while her meeting management is slightly better than former Chair Choo Mi-ae," she is "fundamentally not qualified." Na claimed, "I said yesterday that (Chair Seo) should resign. What's the biggest task for this Judiciary Committee chair, what we can anticipate, what they need to do? Isn't it to withdraw the indictment against the president? Chair Seo Young-kyo has been someone who has volunteered as the president's defender all along." (전날 법사위원장으로 선출된 서영교 의원을 두고는 “회의 진행은 추미애 (전) 위원장보다 조금 낫다”면서도 “근본적인 자격이 안 된다”고 평가했다. 나 의원은 “어제 (서 위원장이) 사퇴해야 된다고 말을 했는데, 이번 법사위원장이 할 가장 큰, 어떻게 보면 우리가 예상할, 그들이 해야 할 일이 뭐겠나. 대통령 공소취소하는 거 아닌가”라며 “여태까지 대통령 수호대를 자처한 분이 서영교 위원장”이라고 주장했다.)

When the host then mentioned former Democratic Party leader Jeong Cheong-rae, Governor Choo Mi-ae, and lawmaker Seo Young-kyo, who have recently served as Judiciary Committee chairs, and asked, "Who is still the best?" Na replied, "Rather, Chair Choo Mi-ae might be better." Na added, "Since she was so disliked by the public, the moment Chair Choo Mi-ae stepped in, I think people thought, 'That Judiciary Committee is indeed strange.'" (이어 진행자가 최근 법사위원장을 맡았던 정청래 전 민주당 대표와 추미애 지사, 서영교 의원을 언급하며 “누가 그래도 제일 낫냐”고 묻자 나 의원은 “차라리 추미애 위원장이 나을 수 있다”고 답했다. 나 의원은 “하도 국민들한테 비호감이었으니까 추미애 위원장이 나서는 순간 ‘저 법사위 이상한 것 맞구나’ 하는 생각을 하는 것 같다”고 덧붙였다.)

Na also said she would not join the Judiciary Committee this time. "I have work to do on the Judiciary Committee, but now other issues, such as power problems related to semiconductor investment in the Honam region or labor issues, are in a very critical period," Na said. "I've applied for the Climate, Energy, Environment, and Labor Committee, but I'm not sure how it will turn out." (나 의원은 이번에는 법사위에 가지 않겠다고도 했다. 나 의원은 “법사위에서 제가 해야 될 일이 있지만, 지금 또 다른 이슈들, 예컨대 호남 반도체 투자와 관련된 전력 문제라든지 노동 문제 같은 것이 굉장히 지금 중요한 시기”라며 “기후에너지환경노동위원회를 신청했는데 어떻게 될지 모르겠다”고 했다.)

Reporter Jeon Gwang-jun light@hani.co.kr (전광준 기자 light@hani.co.kr)

item.title: DP: "Begin practical discussions on abolishing supplementary investigative powers... July extraordinary session convened" (민주 “‘보완수사권 폐지’ 등 실무 논의 시작…7월 임시국회 소집”)
item.description:
Han Byung-do, acting chair and floor leader of the Democratic Party, stated on the 2nd, "We will launch a task force (TF) to revise the Criminal Procedure Act, centered around the floor leadership, the Policy Committee, and the Legislation and Judiciary Committee, and begin practical discussions." Regarding the revision of the Criminal Procedure Act, which will decide whether to abolish the prosecution's supplementary investigative powers, the government has passed the ball to the National Assembly without presenting its own proposal, leading to calls within the party for a discussion body. (한병도 더불어민주당 당대표 직무대행 겸 원내대표가 “원내 지도부와 정책위, 법제사법위원회를 중심으로 형사소송법 개정 태스크포스(TF)를 출범시켜 실무 논의를 시작하겠다”라고 2일 밝혔다. 검찰의 보완수사권 존폐를 결정할 형사소송법 개정과 관련해 정부가 정부안을 내지 않고 국회에 공을 넘기면서 당내에서는 논의 기구가 필요하다는 목소리가 나오던 상황이었다.)

Acting leader Han held a policy coordination meeting at the National Assembly on the same day and said, "The Democratic Party will accelerate the completion of prosecution reform," adding, "The TF will promptly devise measures to flawlessly fulfill the era's tasks of completely separating investigative and indicting powers and abolishing supplementary investigative powers." He continued, "The goal of prosecution reform is to protect the rights and interests of the people and their human rights," and "We will concentrate all efforts on building a criminal justice system that earns public trust." (한 직무대행은 이날 국회에서 정책조정회의를 열고 “민주당은 검찰 개혁 완성에 박차를 가하겠다”며 “티에프에서 수사권과 기소권의 완전한 분리, 보완수사권 폐지라는 시대적 과제를 빈틈없이 완수할 방안을 신속히 강구하겠다”고 말했다. 이어 “검찰개혁의 목표는 국민 권익과 인권 보호”라며 “국민의 신뢰를 받는 형사사법 시스템 구축에 모든 역량을 집중하겠다”고 했다.)

Additionally, Floor Leader Han announced, "The Democratic Party will convene an extraordinary session of the National Assembly in July," and "Even if it's just the 11 standing committees (10 standing committees and the Budget and Accounts Special Committee) with elected chairs, we will first hold meetings to address urgent livelihood issues." He noted, "The floor leadership had a dinner with the president the previous day to discuss future legislative tasks," and "We will accelerate efforts to enact special laws for mega-special zones and secure infrastructure investment budgets centered around the TF supporting the three mega-projects." He also emphasized, "The National Assembly must carry out livelihood-related legislation to ensure measures such as closures, easing the repayment burden of policy funds for small business owners, and state payment of unpaid wages to protect workers at bankrupt businesses are implemented without a hitch." (아울러 한 원내대표는 “민주당은 7월 임시국회를 소집하겠다”며 “위원장이 선출된 11개 상임위(10개 상임위와 예산결산특별위원회)만이라도 먼저 회의를 열어 시급한 민생 현안을 살피겠다”고 밝혔다. 그는 “원내지도부가 전날 대통령과 만찬을 갖고 향후 입법 과제를 논의했다”며 “3대 메가프로젝트 지원 티에프를 중심으로 메가특구 특별법 제정과 인프라 투자 예산 확보에도 박차를 가하겠다”고 말했다. 또 “폐업, 소상공인 정책자금 상환 부담 완화 조치, 도산 사업장 근로자 보호를 위한 체불임금 국가 지급 등 생계와 직결된 대책들이 차질 없이 집행되도록 국회가 (민생 입법을) 해야 한다”고도 강조했다.)

Addressing the People Power Party, he said, "We sternly ask the People Power Party: Why do you refuse to assign standing committee members based on the National Assembly Speaker's authority, submit mass resignations, and attempt to paralyze the National Assembly?" adding, "You must not boycott even people's livelihoods." He further stated, "We expect the People Power Party to stop its pointless stubbornness and present a forward-looking stance, even as early as today." (국민의힘을 향해서는 “국민의힘에 엄중히 묻는다. 국회의장 권한에 따른 상임위 (의원 명단) 배정마저 거부하고 전원 사임계를 제출해 국회를 마비시키려는 이유가 도대체 무엇이냐”며 “민생마저 보이콧해서는 안 된다”고 말했다. 이어 “국민의힘이 무의미한 고집을 멈추고 오늘이라도 전향적인 입장을 내어놓기를 기대한다”고 덧붙였다.)

By Jeong Hye-min, reporter jhm@hani.co.kr and Kim Chae-woon, reporter cwk@hani.co.kr (정혜민 기자 jhm@hani.co.kr 김채운 기자 cwk@hani.co.kr)

item.title: Prime Minister Han Seung-sook: "Focus on Resolving People's Livelihood Issues... Price Management Top Priority" (한성숙 총리 “민생현안 해결에 사력…물가 관리가 최우선”)
item.description:
Prime Minister Han Seung-sook stated on the 2nd, "We will do our utmost to introduce the work-type AI (artificial intelligence) system, currently in pilot operation at four ministries, to all ministries by the end of the year along with the Ministry of the Interior and Safety." (한성숙 국무총리는 2일 “현재 4개 부처에서 시범 운영 중인 업무형 에이아이(AI·인공지능) 시스템을 행정안전부와 함께 연말까지 모든 부처에 도입하는 데 최선을 다하겠다”고 밝혔다.)

At her inauguration ceremony held at the Government Complex Sejong, Prime Minister Han said, "The standard for the people's sovereign government's administration lies solely in the lives of the people." She added, "I deeply thank the President for trusting me and entrusting me with the cabinet during this period of great transformation. I take the voices of 52 million sovereign citizens seriously and will devote all my efforts to resolving the pressing livelihood issues we face." Prime Minister Han outlined key future tasks, including △ AI transformation, △ Growth for all citizens, and △ Balanced regional-led economic growth. She also promised to actively pursue data-based administration. <<> Prior to her inauguration, Prime Minister Han emphasized people's livelihoods while chairing an emergency economic review meeting for the first time. She urged, "We must focus with utmost priority on managing prices that burden ordinary people's lives. Please give top priority to stabilizing prices by monitoring price trends for livelihood-related items in real-time and swiftly and decisively implementing tailored supply and demand measures." She also stressed, "In addition to high oil prices and exchange rates, the possibility of major countries raising benchmark interest rates is increasing, necessitating close government response." <<> Furthermore, she stated, "In preparation for stabilizing the situation in the Middle East, we must also prepare measures to strengthen cooperation with the Middle East in advance," and added, "While recovering exports to the Middle East, such as general machinery and automobiles, please actively explore ways in which we can contribute to post-war reconstruction efforts." <<> Reporter Jeong Hye-min jhm@hani.co.kr (한 총리는 이날 정부세종청사에서 열린 취임식에서 “국민주권정부 국정의 기준은 오로지 국민의 삶에 있다”라며 이렇게 말했다. 한 총리는 “대전환의 시기에 이렇게 무거운 자리에 저를 믿고 내각을 맡겨 주신 대통령님께 깊이 감사드린다”며 “저는 5200만 주권자의 목소리를 무겁게 받아들여, 당면한 민생 현안 해결에 사력을 다하겠다”고 말했다. 한 총리는 앞으로의 주요 과제로 △에이아이 대전환 △국민 모두의 성장 △지방주도 경제균형 성장을 제시했다. 또 데이터 기반 행정을 적극 추진하겠다고 약속했다.)

item.title: People Power Party Says "Penalty Too Severe, Disadvantages for College Admissions" Regarding Baejae High School's Six-Month Suspension (국힘, 배재고 6개월 출전정지에 “징계 과해, 입시에 불이익”)
item.description:
The leadership of the People Power Party (PPP) on the 2nd uniformly criticized the Korea Baseball Softball Association's decision to impose a six-month suspension from national tournaments on the Baejae High School baseball team, which has been embroiled in controversy for disparaging the May 18 Democratic Uprising, calling it an "excessive measure." (국민의힘 지도부가 2일 5·18 민주화운동 비하 논란을 빚고 있는 배재고 야구부에 대한야구소프트볼협회가 전국대회 6개월 출전정지 징계를 내린 데 대해 “과도한 조치”라고 일제히 비판했다.)

PPP Supreme Council member Yang Hyang-ja, a native of Gwangju, said at a Supreme Council meeting held at the National Assembly that day, "The issue of a high school baseball team's mocking cheers is escalating into a fight between progressive and conservative camps," adding, "We should exercise restraint. We need to be cautious." Yang continued, "This penalty could collapse due to disadvantages in college admissions," and argued, "While extreme and hateful expressions are clearly wrong and greatly violate the spirit of sports, the punishment is too severe." She also stated, "Efforts are needed to prevent extremism not only in home education but also in the public system of school education." <<> Supreme Council member Kim Jae-won also claimed, "The penalty is clearly excessive and violent," and "The association's disciplinary standards for disorder in the stadium are vague regulations without even detailed sentencing criteria." He then asked, "Does this really amount to insulting the May 18 events?" adding, "From the beginning, the problem lies in the president himself stepping forward to take an extreme stance on the Starbucks incident." Youth Supreme Council member Woo Jae-joon also said, "Young people feel antipathy toward the fact that the president and ministers have gone so far as to call for a boycott against a company just for disparaging May 18, which seems somewhat excessively unbalanced." (광주 출신인 양향자 국민의힘 최고위원은 이날 국회에서 열린 최고위원회의에서 “한 고등학교 야구부의 조롱 섞인 응원 문제가 진보 보수 진영 간 싸움으로 번지고 있다”며 “자중해야 한다. 신중해야 한다”고 말했다. 양 최고위원은 “이 징계는 대학 입시의 불이익으로 무너질 수 있다”며 “극단적이고 혐오적인 표현은 명백한 잘못이고, 스포츠 정신에도 크게 어긋나는 것이 맞지만 벌이 너무 과하다”고 했다. 그러면서 “가정 교육은 물론 학교 교육이라는 공적 시스템에서도 극단을 막는 노력이 필요하다”고 했다.)

Earlier, floor leader Jeong Jeom-sik requested the Korea Baseball Softball Association to reconsider on Facebook the previous day, saying, "While it was inappropriate behavior as it involved disparaging the May 18 Democratic Uprising, the six-month suspension from national tournaments is an excessive measure." (김재원 최고위원도 “징계는 명백히 과도하고 폭력적”이라며 “협회 단체의 징계 기준상 경기장 질서 문란은 세부적인 양형 기준조차 없는 모호한 규정”이라고 주장했다. 이어 “이것이 정말 5·18 모욕에 해당하느냐”며 “당초부터 스타벅스 사태를 대통령까지 나서서 극단적으로 주장한 것 자체가 문제가 있다”고 했다. 우재준 청년 최고위원도 “5·18을 비하했다고 해서 대통령과 장관까지 나서서 기업에 대해 불매운동에 나서는 것들이 다소 지나치게 균형을 잃었다고 하는 점에 대해서 (청년들이) 반감을 가지는 것”이라고 했다.)

Previously, on the 29th of last month, during the first round of the Cheongryonggi tournament against Gwangju Jeil High School at Mokdong Stadium in Yangcheon-gu, Seoul, Baejae High School repeatedly chanted a cheer song containing the lyrics, "Let's go, let's go, let's go to Starbucks," sparking controversy. During this, one student shouted, "Tank Day." This slogan has drawn public outrage as it evokes the incident where Starbucks Korea promoted a tumbler discount event on the anniversary of the May 18 Democratic Uprising under the banner "May 18 Tank Day." <<> Reporter Kim Hae-jeong sea@hani.co.kr Reporter Jo Hee-yeon choh@hani.co.kr (앞서 정점식 원내대표는 전날 페이스북에 “5.18 민주화운동을 비하한 측면이 있어 부적절한 행동”이라면서도 “전국대회 출전 6개월 정지 징계는 지나친 조치”라고 대한야구소프트볼협회에 재고를 요청했다.)

item.title: President Lee: “Chungcheong to be the Hub of AI Innovation…Claim of Pressure on Lee Jae-yong to Invest is an Outdated View” (이 대통령 “충청, AI 혁신 중심으로…이재용 투자 압박설은 구태”)
item.description:
President Lee Jae-myung said on the 2nd, “There are some with the outdated view that I pressured Samsung Electronics Chairman Lee Jae-yong, leading Samsung to make a massive regional investment decision. Would corporate management be possible under such pressure?” This appears to rebut claims from opposition circles that President Lee pressured Samsung Electronics and SK Hynix, among others, to secure large-scale provincial investments. (이재명 대통령이 2일 “제가 이재용 삼성전자 회장한테 압박해서 삼성전자가 (지역에 대규모 투자) 결정한 거 아닐까 구태적인 생각을 하는 분이 계신데, 그렇게 하면 기업경영을 할 수 있겠냐”고 말했다. 야권을 중심으로 이 대통령이 삼성전자와 에스케이(SK)하이닉스 등을 압박해 대규모 지방 투자를 끌어냈다고 주장하고 있는데, 이를 반박한 것으로 보인다.)

In a congratulatory speech at the “Chungcheong Region Advanced Industry Development Vision National Report Meeting” held in Asan, South Chungcheong Province, the President stated, “A completely new world is unfolding, and to race ahead at the forefront, we must engage in the most advanced thinking, which others are not doing. Thinking that you can force companies to invest by applying pressure, based on the mindset of the past era of government-directed administration, is itself outdated.” He added, “The government must continuously persuade companies for balanced regional development, create an environment where companies can make investment decisions, and invest government finances and capabilities for this purpose. Just applying pressure to come unconditionally—where in today’s world would companies relocate under such conditions?” (이 대통령은 이날 충남 아산시에서 열린 ‘충청권 첨단산업 발전비전 국민보고회’ 축사에서 “완전히 새로운 세상이 열리고 있고, 우리가 가장 선두에 달려나가려면 남들이 하지 않는 가장 선진적인 생각을 해야 한다”며 “과거 관치 행정하던 시절 생각으로 (기업에) 압력을 넣어서 강제로 (투자하게) 할 수 있겠다고 생각하는 것 자체가 구태”라고 말했다. 그러면서 이 대통령은 “정부는 지속적으로 지역균형 발전을 위해 기업을 설득하고, 기업이 투자 결정을 할 수 있는 환경을 만들어내고, 또 이를 위해 정부의 재정이나 역량이 투입돼야 한다”며 “무조건 오라고 압력 넣는다고, 요즘 세상에 기업들이 옮겨오는 데가 어딨냐”고 말했다.)

He also cautioned against approaching large-scale provincial investments as a “regional handout.” President Lee said, “Local government heads sometimes face stress from residents who ask, ‘Why not our neighborhood?’ Even so, we must not approach this divisively.” He continued, “Because the nation’s survival is under threat, the most important tasks now are balanced regional development, decentralization from the metropolitan area, and region-centered growth strategies. We should support companies to locate in the best possible sites.” (또 대규모 지방 투자를 ‘지방 나눠주기식’으로 접근해선 안 된다고 말했다. 이 대통령은 “지방자치를 담당하는 단체장들은 가끔 주민들에게 ‘왜 우리 동네는 안 되는 거야’라는 지적을 받다보니 스트레스를 받는 경우도 있는 것 같다”며 “그렇다고 하더라도 분열적으로 접근해선 안 된다”고 강조했다. 이어 “국가 생존이 위협받는 상태가 됐기 때문에 지금의 가장 중요한 과제는 지방균형 발전, 수도권 분산, 또 지방 중심 성장 전략”이라며 “가능하면 가장 좋은 입지에 기업들이 입지할 수 있게 지원해야 한다”고 말했다.)

The President emphasized, “This is not about handing out gifts. If we place one semiconductor fab in Gwangju and one somewhere else, corporate operations would be impossible. But some ask, ‘Why aren’t you distributing these?’ We must not take that approach. The government’s role—and politics’ role—is to create conditions so that companies, aligning their interests, see it as far better to operate here.” He added, “Without special efforts, it’s understandable that residents get upset asking why our neighborhood isn’t getting a share. But if politicians also get swept up in that anger, how would that neighborhood develop?” (이 대통령은 “이건 선물 나눠주기가 아니다. 광주에 반도체 팹 한 개, 어디에 한 개 이런 식으로 하면 기업 운영을 할 수가 없다”며 “그런데 이걸 왜 나눠주지 않냐, 이렇게 접근하면 안 된다. 기업들의 이해관계가 맞아떨어져서 여기서 하는 게 훨씬 낫겠다는 생각을 할 수 있도록 상황을 만들어주는 게 정부가 하는 일, 정치가 하는 일”이라고 말했다. 이 대통령은 “노력을 특별히 기울이지 않은 상태에서 왜 우리 동네 안 나눠준다고 화내고, 주민들은 섭섭할 수 있다. 그러나 정치하는 사람들은 부화뇌동해서 같이 화내고 그러면 그 동네가 발전이 되겠냐”고 했다.)

These remarks by President Lee were not in his prepared script. They appear to reiterate, in response to the People Power Party’s criticism of the government’s Honam semiconductor cluster plan as a ‘political decision,’ that corporate investments should be driven by the government’s creation of a favorable investment environment. (이 대통령의 이런 발언은 원고에 없던 것이다. 국민의힘이 정부의 호남 반도체 클러스터 조성 등을 ‘정치적 결정'이라고 비난하는 데 대해, 기업 투자는 정부의 투자 환경 조성을 통해 이뤄져야 한다는 점을 거듭 강조한 것으로 보인다.)

Additionally, President Lee addressed Samsung Electronics Chairman Lee Jae-yong, who had earlier announced plans to develop the Chungcheong region into a hub for core semiconductor materials and components. President Lee said, “Listening to Chairman Lee’s remarks, I was reminded of the historic moment in 1983 when the late Chairman Lee Byung-chul declared the semiconductor industry’s advancement in Tokyo. Just as that day’s foresight made South Korea a semiconductor powerhouse, I am confident that Chairman Lee’s decision today will lead a new leap in South Korea’s advanced industries.” He added, “Therefore, the investment plans announced today are not merely about expanding companies’ production facilities to the Chungcheong region. They represent a promise of trust to completely shift the growth paradigm toward a better future and a bold declaration of South Korea’s potential.” (아울러 이 대통령은 앞서 충청권을 반도체 핵심 소재·부품 거점으로 육성하겠다는 계획을 발표한 이재용 삼성전자 회장을 향해 “이 회장의 말씀을 들으며, 고 이병철 회장께서 1983년 도쿄에서 반도체 산업 진출을 선언하셨던 역사적 순간이 떠올랐다”며 “그날의 선견지명이 대한민국을 반도체 강국으로 만들었듯이, 오늘 이 회장의 결단이 대한민국 첨단산업의 새로운 도약을 선도할 것이라 확신한다”고 말했다. 이 대통령은 “그렇기에 오늘 발표한 투자계획들은 단지 기업들의 생산시설이 충청권으로 확장된다는 의미가 아니다”라며 “성장의 패러다임을 완전히 바꿔 더 나은 미래를 향해 나아가겠다는 신뢰의 약속이자, 대한민국의 가능성을 향한 담대한 선언”이라고 덧붙였다.)

Samsung Electronics and SK Hynix, among others, have committed to investing a total of 392 trillion won in the Chungcheong region, including 156 trillion won for semiconductors, 150 trillion won for AI data centers, and 86 trillion won for displays, batteries, and biotechnology. (삼성전자와 에스케이(SK)하이닉스 등은 반도체 156조원, 에이아이(AI) 데이터센터 150조원, 기타 디스플레이·배터리·바이오에 86조원을 포함해 충청권에 총 392조원을 투자하기로 한 상태다.)

Reported by Seo Young-ji yj@hani.co.kr and Ko Kyung-ju goh@hani.co.kr (서영지 기자 yj@hani.co.kr 고경주 기자 goh@hani.co.kr)

item.title: President Lee’s Approval Rating at 58%… Democratic Party 42%, People Power Party 20% [NBS] (이 대통령 지지율 58%…민주 42% 국힘 20% [NBS])
item.description:
A poll shows that President Lee Jae-myung’s approval rating for state affairs stands at 58%, similar to three weeks ago (57%). The support rate for the Democratic Party of Korea was 42%, and for the People Power Party, it was 20%. (이재명 대통령의 국정운영 평가가 3주 전(57%)과 비슷한 58%를 기록했다는 여론조사 결과가 나왔다. 더불어민주당 지지율은 42%, 국민의힘은 20%로 집계됐다.)

According to the National Barometer Survey (NBS) conducted from June 29 to July 1 by Embrain Public, K-Stat Research, Korea Research, and Hankook Research, and released on the 2nd (telephone interview survey, with a sampling error of ±3.1 percentage points at a 95% confidence level), the positive assessment that President Lee is “doing well” in managing state affairs was 58%. In the previous survey three weeks ago (June 8-10), it was 57%. The negative assessment of “doing poorly” was 35%, while 7% responded with “don’t know” or no answer. (엠브레인퍼블릭·케이스탯리서치·코리아리서치·한국리서치가 6월29일~7월1일 조사해 2일 공개한 전국지표조사(NBS) 결과(전화면접조사, 표본오차는 95% 신뢰수준에 ±3.1%포인트)를 보면, 이 대통령의 국정운영에 대해 ‘잘하고 있다’는 긍정 평가는 58%를 기록했다. 직전 조사인 3주 전(6월8~10일)에는 57%였다. ‘잘못하고 있다’는 부정평가는 35%, 모름·무응답은 7%였다.)

Regarding the direction of the Lee Jae-myung administration’s state affairs, 56% evaluated it as “in the right direction,” while 36% answered it was “in the wrong direction.” When asked about evaluations of major policy areas of the Lee Jae-myung administration, the “positive” opinion on public safety policies (disaster and calamity preparedness, etc.) was 61%. For balanced regional development policies (strengthening local competitiveness, etc.), it was 55%; for pension policies (national pension, basic pension, etc.), 53%; for education policies (fostering future talent and bridging education gaps, etc.), 50%; and for labor policies (labor-management relations and labor market structural improvement, etc.), 48% gave a “positive” evaluation. Amid positive assessments leading among progressive and moderate groups, the moderate group uniquely recorded a positive assessment of labor policies (48%) below 50%. (이재명 정부 국정운영 방향에 대해 ‘올바른 방향’이라는 평가는 56%였다. ‘잘못된 방향’이라는 답변은 36%였다. 이재명 정부 주요 정책 분야에 대한 평가를 각각 물었더니 국민 생활 안전정책(재해·재난 대비 등)에 대한 ‘긍정’ 의견은 61%였다. 지역균형발전정책(지방 경쟁력 강화 등)에 대해선 55%, 연금정책(국민연금·기초연금 등)에 대해선 53%, 교육정책(미래인재 양성 및 교육격차 해소 등)에 대해선 50%, 노동정책(노사관계 및 노동시장 구조개선 등)에 대해선 48%가 ‘긍정’이라고 평가했다. 진보층과 중도층이 긍정평가를 이끈 가운데, 중도층에선 유일하게 노동정책에 대한 긍정평가(48%)가 50% 미만을 기록했다.)

Support for the Democratic Party stood at 42%, similar to the previous survey (41%). The People Power Party recorded 20%, showing a difference from the previous survey (25%). The gap in support between the two parties widened from 16 percentage points to 22 percentage points in three weeks. This was followed by the Reform Party at 2%, the Justice Party at 2%, and the Progressive Party at 1%. Attitude reservation (no supporting party, don’t know, no answer) was 30%. For more details, refer to the website of the Central Election Public Opinion Survey Review Committee. (민주당 지지도는 42%로, 직전 조사(41%)와 엇비슷했다. 국민의힘 20%로 직전 조사(25%)와 차이를 보였다. 양당 지지도 격차는 3주 만에 16%포인트에서 22%포인트로 벌어졌다. 이어 개혁신당 2%, 조국혁신당 2%, 진보당 1% 차례였다. 태도유보(지지정당 없음·모름·무응답)는 30%였다. 자세한 내용은 중앙여론조사심의위원회 누리집을 참조하면 된다.)

Reporter Jo Hee-yeon choh@hani.co.kr (조희연 기자 choh@hani.co.kr)

item.title: Army: Pancreatitis Under Treatment Before Entry Confirmed as Cause of Reserve Soldier’s Death (육군, 예비군 사망 원인에 “입소 전 치료받던 췌장염”)
item.description:
The Army announced that an investigation into the death of a reserve soldier in his 20s, who died during a mobilization training exercise in Pocheon, Gyeonggi Province, in May, has confirmed that pancreatitis, which the deceased was being treated for before entering the training, was the cause of death. The deceased reserve soldier participated in the Ssangyong Training conducted in the northern Gyeonggi region from May 12 to 14. The Ssangyong Training is a large-scale national mobilization exercise involving reserve forces, focusing on verifying joint operations with active-duty units. (육군이 지난 5월 경기 포천에서 동원훈련에 참가한 20대 예비군 사망 사건을 조사한 결과, 숨진 예비군이 입소 전부터 치료받던 췌장염이 사망 원인으로 확인됐다고 발표했다. 숨진 예비군은 지난 5월12~14일 경기 북부 지역에서 실시된 쌍룡훈련에 참가했다. 쌍룡훈련은 예비군이 참가하는 전국 단위 대규모 동원훈련으로 현역부대와의 연계작전을 검증하는 것에 중점을 두고 이뤄진다.)

At a press briefing held at the Ministry of National Defense building in Yongsan-gu, Seoul, on the 2nd, Vice Chief of Staff of the Army (Lieutenant General) Choi Jang-sik stated, “Following an autopsy conducted with the family present, it was determined that pancreatitis, which the deceased had been receiving treatment for before entering the training, was the cause of death.” He added, “We consulted two private forensic advisory institutions and additionally confirmed that the condition had a causal relationship with the death.” (최장식 육군참모차장(중장)은 2일 서울 용산구 국방부 청사에서 열린 언론브리핑에서 “가족 입회하에 부검을 실시한 결과, 고인이 훈련 입소 전부터 치료받고 있던 췌장염이 사망 원인으로 판단됐다”며 “민간 법의자문기관 2개소에 의뢰해 해당 질환이 사망과 인과관계가 있다는 소견을 추가로 확인했다”고 밝혔다.)

The deceased reserve soldier collapsed and lost consciousness while walking to a night training site on the evening of May 13, leading to claims that the intense training in extreme heat was the cause of death. It was revealed that the training site lacked emergency equipment and medical personnel, sparking controversy. President Lee Jae-myung ordered a fact-finding investigation during a Cabinet meeting on the 2nd of last month. (숨진 예비군은 지난 5월13일 저녁 야간 훈련장소로 걸어서 이동하다 의식을 잃고 쓰러져 폭염 속 강도 높은 훈련이 사망 원인이란 주장이 나왔다. 훈련 현장에는 응급 장비, 의료 인력이 없었던 것으로 드러나 논란이 커졌고, 이재명 대통령은 지난달 2일 국무회의에서 진상규명을 지시했다.)

Regarding claims that a division commander monitored reserve soldiers using a drone during the training, the Army explained, “The drone operated at the time was used for promotional and situational purposes, and investigations showed that the division commander was elsewhere providing on-site guidance to other units.” (육군은 훈련 당시 사단장이 드론으로 예비군을 감시했다는 주장에 대해 “당시 운용한 드론은 홍보 및 상황 조성용이었으며, 사단장은 다른 부대 현장 지도 중이었던 것으로 조사됐다”고 설명했다.)

The Army acknowledged that some deficiencies, including in medical support and safety control, were identified during the investigation into the reserve soldier’s death. It announced plans to improve the medical support system, such as ensuring that medical evacuation teams are permanently stationed at all reserve training sites. Automated external defibrillators will also be expanded from battalion-level to company-level distribution. (육군은 예비군 사망사고 조사 과정에서 의무지원 및 안전통제 등 일부 미흡한 점도 확인됐다며 모든 예비군 훈련장에 의무후송팀이 반드시 상주하도록 하는 등 의무지원체계를 개선하기로 했다. 자동제세동기를 대대급에서 중대급까지 확대 보급하기로 했다.)

Reporter Kwon Hyuk-cheol: nura@hani.co.kr (권혁철 기자 nura@hani.co.kr)

item.title: President Lee: "Megaprojects Are Not Just Favors for Regions... The Path to a Korean-Style Silicon Valley" (이 대통령 “메가프로젝트, 지방 시혜 아냐…한국판 실리콘밸리 가는 길”)
item.description:
President Lee Jae-myung stated on the 2nd regarding the government's recently announced "Three Mega Projects for the Great Leap of the Republic of Korea," saying, "These are not mere favors for the regions but the only path for Korea to become the ultimate victor of the Fourth Industrial Revolution and a historic decision for future generations." (이재명 대통령이 2일 정부가 최근 발표한 ‘대한민국 대도약 3대 메가 프로젝트’와 관련해 “단순한 지방에 대한 시혜가 아니라, 대한민국이 4차산업 혁명의 최종승자가 되는 유일한 길이자 미래 세대를 위한 역사적 결단”이라고 말했다.)

During a meeting of senior secretaries held at the Blue House that day, the President said, "This will serve as the driving force to transcend the limited Seoul metropolitan area, multi-polarize the growth axis nationwide, and transform the entire country into a Korean-style Silicon Valley." (이 대통령은 이날 청와대에서 주재한 수석보좌관 회의에서 “한계에 직면한 수도권을 넘어 성장의 축을 전국으로 다극화하면서, 국토 전체를 한국판 실리콘밸리로 탈바꿈시키는 원동력이 될 것”이라며 이렇게 말했다.)

President Lee emphasized, "Looking back, previous governments have always opened the door to greater leaps through new challenges at historical crossroads. In the 1970s, the Park Chung-hee government led the way for an export-driven nation by fostering heavy and chemical industries, and in the 2000s, the Kim Dae-jung government paved the path for an IT powerhouse. Our people's sovereignty government's three mega projects will become the third stepping stone for Korea to stand tall as a super-gap industrial powerhouse." (이 대통령은 “되돌아보면 역대 정부들도 시대의 갈림길에서 언제나 새로운 도전을 통해 더 큰 도약의 문을 열어왔다. 1970년대 박정희 정부는 중화학공업 육성으로 수출입국의 길을 열었고, 2000년대 김대중 정부는 아이티(IT) 기술 대국의 길을 닦았다”며 “우리 국민주권 정부의 3대 메가 프로젝트는 대한민국이 초격차 산업 강국으로 우뚝 서는 세 번째 디딤돌이 될 것”이라고 강조했다.)

He also urged a rapid approach to follow-up measures. President Lee said, "The Blue House and government must prioritize the overhaul of related policies and laws, as well as budget allocation, and speed up project implementation. Please also ensure perfection in the establishment and execution of additional investment plans to come." He added, "I ask the people, businesses, the government, and the political circle to unite their strength on this path that will take responsibility for Korea's next 30 years and open wider windows of opportunity for all young people across the nation." (후속 조처를 위한 속도전도 당부했다. 이 대통령은 “청와대와 정부는 이와 관련한 정책·법령의 정비, 예산 배정을 국정의 최우선 순위에 올려놓고 사업 진행에 속도를 내야 한다”며 “추가로 이어질 투자계획 수립과 추진에도 만전을 기해달라”고 말했다. 그러면서 “대한민국의 미래 30년을 책임지고 전국의 모든 청년에게 더 큰 기회의 창을 열어줄 이 길에 국민과 기업, 정부, 정치권 모두 하나 된 힘을 모아달라”고 당부했다.)

He also called for active policy responses to mitigate polarization. President Lee stated, "One of the biggest challenges to tackle alongside creating future growth engines is alleviating the deep-seated imbalances and gaps present in every corner of society. If the K-shaped polarization is left unattended, productivity will decline, growth potential will be undermined, and even national unity and social stability will be shaken." He ordered, "We must adopt a posture where the success of state affairs hinges on easing polarization and implement multifaceted policy responses. To this end, we must focus on strengthening the basic safety net, forming a fair labor market, revitalizing neighborhood economies, and building a ladder of assets for everyone, including young people." (양극화 완화에 대한 적극적인 정책대응도 주문했다. 이 대통령은 “미래 성장 동력 창출과 동시에 해결해야 할 가장 큰 과제 중 하나는 사회 곳곳에 깊숙이 자리한 불균형과 격차의 완화”라며 “케이(K)자형 양극화를 방치하면 생산성이 떨어지고 성장 잠재력이 훼손되고 나아가 국민 통합과 사회의 안정성마저 흔들리게 된다”고 말했다. 이 대통령은 “양극화 완화에 국정의 성패가 달렸다는 자세로 다각도의 정책 대응에 나서야 한다”며 “이를 위해 기본적 생활 안전망 강화를 토대로 공정한 노동시장 형성, 골목 경제 활성화, 청년을 포함한 모두의 자산 사다리 구축에 총력을 기울여야 한다”고 주문했다.)

President Lee further requested, "In particular, efficiently utilize the anticipated additional tax revenue to perfectly establish stable investment resources for future generations." (이 대통령은 또 “특히 최근에 예상되는 추가 세수를 효율적으로 활용해 미래 세대를 위한 안정적인 투자 재원을 조성하는 일도 완벽히 해달라”고 요청했다.)
